default_in_repayment.text:
(a)	In our opinion, the Company has not defaulted in the repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender during the year.

(b)	The Company has not been declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.

(c)	To the best of our knowledge and belief, in our opinion, term loans availed by the Company were, applied by the Company during the year for the purposes for which the loans were obtained.

(d)	On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, funds raised on short-term basis have, prima facie, not been used during the year for long-term purposes by the Company.

(e)	On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries.

(f)	The Company has not raised loans during the year on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiaries.

fraud.text:
(a)	To the best of our knowledge, no fraud by the Company and no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year.

(b)	To the best of our knowledge, no report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and upto the date of this report.

(c)	As represented to us by the Management, there were no whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year.

timeline.summary: India Ratings upgraded Syrma SGS's long-term bank loan facilities to IND AA/Stable and affirmed commercial paper at IND A1+ on May 5, 2026.
Syrma SGS reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,220.7 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹1.50 per share.
Syrma SGS reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,477 Cr (up 56% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹4,819 Cr (up 27% YoY) on May 11, 2026.
Syrma SGS and Premier Energies terminated the proposed acquisition of a 49% stake in Ksolare Energy due to unfulfilled conditions precedent.
Syrma SGS Technology Limited uploaded the audio recording of its conference call for audited financial results (Q4FY26 & FY26) on May 12, 2026, via its website.
Syrma SGS reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,857 Cr and operating EBITDA of ₹545 Cr, guiding for 30-35% growth in FY27.
Syrma SGS reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,819 Cr (up 27% YoY) and PAT of ₹345.8 Cr (up 87% YoY).
Syrma SGS Q1FY27 revenue rose 67% YoY to ₹1,604 Cr with PAT up 112% to ₹106 Cr; order book ₹6,770 Cr and PCB commercial production guided for April 2027.
Syrma SGS scheduled its Q2FY27 earnings conference call for November 2, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,989.68 Cr, net profit ₹124.2 Cr (+87.2% YoY).
Syrma SGS reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,999.5 Cr (up 73% YoY) and PAT of ₹124.2 Cr (up 87% YoY).
